findings.title: Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria
findings.summary: Supported by 1 source(s); strongest: Post-Matric Scholarship Notice 2026-27 (Trap Lab Department of Welfare) (Primary).
findings.value: Undergraduate students with parental annual income up to Rs 2,50,000 are eligible.

sources.value: Undergraduate students with parental annual income up to Rs 2,50,000 are eligible.
sources.quote: Students whose parents' or guardians' annual income from all sources does not exceed Rs 2,50,000 are eligible for the 2026-27 session.

sources.value: Parents' annual income must not exceed Rs 2,50,000.
sources.quote: Students whose parents' annual income does not exceed Rs 2,50,000 are eligible for the 2025-26 session.

findings.note: Ensure your parental annual income is calculated accurately to remain under the Rs 2,50,000 threshold. You might want to keep your recent tax or salary documents ready.

findings.title: Madhya Pradesh Domicile Status
findings.summary: Evidence found only for a different state (Rajasthan), not Madhya Pradesh.
findings.value: Applicants must upload a Rajasthan domicile certificate. (for Rajasthan)

sources.value: Applicants must upload a Rajasthan domicile certificate.
sources.quote: In Rajasthan, applicants for the 2026-27 post-matric scholarship must upload a Rajasthan domicile certificate, otherwise the application is rejected.

findings.note: Double-check whether Madhya Pradesh applicants need a local state domicile or if the Rajasthan reference was an error in the source. Consulting local welfare authorities can prevent rejection.

findings.title: Required Income Documents
findings.summary: Possible conflict: sources for 2026–27 give different values (An income certificate issued by the Tehsildar is mandatory. / A self-declaration of income is enough and no income certificate is needed.).
findings.value: An income certificate issued by the Tehsildar is mandatory.

sources.value: An income certificate issued by the Tehsildar is mandatory.
sources.quote: An income certificate issued by the Tehsildar for the 2026-27 session is mandatory.

sources.value: A self-declaration of income is enough and no income certificate is needed.
sources.quote: For the 2026-27 session you do not need to visit the tehsil office at all, because a self-declaration of income is enough and no income certificate is needed.

sources.value: Self-declaration of income is enough and no income certificate is needed.
sources.quote: For the 2026-27 session you do not need to visit the tehsil office at all, because a self-declaration of income is enough and no income certificate is needed.

findings.note: Because sources conflict on whether a Tehsildar certificate or a self-declaration is needed, it is safer to obtain the Tehsildar certificate in advance. You might also want to check if the portal specifically requires the official certificate upload.

findings.title: Application Deadline 2026-27
findings.summary: Supported by 1 source(s); strongest: Post-Matric Scholarship Notice 2026-27 (Trap Lab Department of Welfare) (Primary).

sources.quote: The last date to submit the online application for the 2026-27 session is 30 November 2026.
The last date to submit the online application for the 2025-26 session is 31 October 2025.

findings.note: Note that the deadline is 30 November 2026, but submitting well before this date is advisable to avoid last-minute portal slowdowns.

findings.title: Scholarship Amount or Rates
findings.summary: Possibly outdated: the only evidence belongs to an earlier cycle than 2026–27.
findings.value: Day scholars Rs 1,200/month, hostellers Rs 2,500/month plus fee reimbursement. (from 2025–26)

sources.value: Day scholars Rs 1,200/month, hostellers Rs 2,500/month plus fee reimbursement.
sources.quote: For the 2025-26 session, day scholars receive a maintenance allowance of Rs 1,200 per month and hostellers receive Rs 2,500 per month,

findings.note: Since the available numbers are from the 2025-26 cycle, check the latest 2026-27 notification for any revised monthly rates or fee caps.

findings.title: Renewal and Continuation Rules
findings.summary: Potential gap: none of the 5 analysed source(s) mention renewal and continuation rules.
findings.note: Keep track of your academic transcripts and attendance records just in case renewal requires maintaining a minimum percentage.

shared_sentences: For the 2026-27 session you do not need to visit the tehsil office at all, because a self-declaration of income is enough and no income certificate is needed.
Many students worry about the documents, but the portal accepts photos taken on a mobile phone as long as they are clear and readable.
Keep your bank passbook ready because the scholarship money is sent directly to your bank account after verification by the institute.
The post matric scholarship process has become very simple this year and many students are applying from their phones.
